**Finding submitted: INSURANCE — missing (fallback insert).**

- **Investigation:** The only "insurance" reference in the document is a deduction item in the net-revenue definition (p0012). Miscellaneous (§14.1–14.10), Indemnification (§8), Limitation of Liability (§9) and Shared Resources (§13) contain no coverage obligation.
- **Why it matters:** Commerce One supplies operations, consulting and engineering personnel working in our hosted environment (§§13.1–13.3) and operates the MarketSite.net Service, so it is a services/hosting vendor touching our and our Customers' data with no insurance behind its indemnities.
- **Cure:** One new §14.11 at the fallback level only — E&O of not less than USD 1,000,000 and cyber/privacy of not less than USD 2,000,000 — with no ancillary survival, at-own-expense or certificate boilerplate, and no neighbouring text disturbed.
